scheme_name: Kalaignar Magalir Urimai Thogai (Tamil Nadu State Scheme)
ministry: Special Programme Implementation Department, Government of Tamil Nadu
benefits_summary: Monthly basic income grant of ₹1,000 deposited directly into the bank account of eligible women family heads across Tamil Nadu.
exclusions: Households owning a four-wheeler or consuming over 3,600 units of electricity per year
documents_required: Tamil Nadu Smart Family Ration Card
application_steps: Attend the local Ration Shop registration camp or visit an e-Sevai / Common Service Centre in Tamil Nadu.
Complete biometric verification with your Smart Ration Card.
Receive ₹1,000 on the 15th of every month via DBT.
